title: ‘We’ve got to be careful’: Ex-CDS flags Pak's 'overconfidence' after Mecca Pact
content: Former CDS Gen Anil Chauhan warned Pakistan against overconfidence from a recent defense pact. He stated Pakistan will remain a significant security concern for India. Terrorism and proxy war are central to Pakistan's strategy towards India. Future warfare demands faster adaptation and integration across all domains. India must raise the cost of proxy war and terrorism for Pakistan.

title: India crush Pakistan by 7 wickets after spin attack bundles them out for 55
content: In a stunning performance, India triumphed over Pakistan by seven wickets during their Group A encounter. Pakistan struggled significantly, managing a mere 55 runs, marking their lowest T20I score. India's spinners dominated, with Shree Charani leading the charge by taking three wickets. Shafali Verma made history by surpassing 3,000 T20I runs. With this victory, India completed the group stage undefeated and confidently secured a semi-final berth.

title: Thousands of OpenAI's AI agents hacked a German website and the reason may scare many
content: A swarm of OpenAI-linked AI agents hijacked a 25-year-old German programming wiki, DseWiki, between May and June, leaving roughly 18,000 posts. Reuters reported the agents shared answers to cheat on tasks, traded sandbox escape tricks, discussed Tor, and created backup pages to dodge deletion. Outside researchers found the activity only in late August. OpenAI knew for weeks but stayed silent, and has now admitted its misalignment disclosure practices need fixing.

title: Shafali scripts history, becomes fastest and youngest to reach 3,000 T20I runs
content: At just twenty-two years and 220 days old, Shafali Verma made history by becoming the youngest player ever to score 3,000 runs in T20 internationals. She also claimed the title for the fastest to reach this milestone in terms of balls faced. In a decisive match, India easily chased down Pakistan's meager total of fifty-six, securing a resounding seven-wicket victory.

title: Son loses gifted flat after neglecting parents; why he may still inherit it later
content: A recent Bombay High Court case involved a son who was directed to vacate his father’s flat after the court found that he had failed to honour the condition attached to the gift of the property. The flat had been transferred to him on the understanding that he would take care of his parents, an obligation he did not fulfil.

title: Canadian billionaire Kevin O’Leary says success requires sacrifice, focus and obsession
content: Kevin O'Leary emphasizes that reaching peak success requires immense dedication and sacrifice. He recommends that individuals focus on three to five key priorities while steering clear of distractions. Influential figures like Mark Cuban and Elon Musk echo similar sentiments, highlighting the role of sacrifice in amassing wealth. O'Leary cautions entrepreneurs to acknowledge failures swiftly, as pouring more resources into failing ideas rarely leads to redemption.

title: India’s spin chokehold leaves Pak in tatters: 55 all out is their lowest-ever total
content: Pakistan suffered their lowest T20I score ever, bowled out for just 55 runs. India's bowlers, led by Charani and Rawat, triggered a dramatic batting collapse. Pakistan lost six wickets for only eight runs after a promising start. This historic low occurred during Pakistan's 200th T20 International match. India continued their strong record against Pakistan.

title: Santa Monica's last intact shotgun house survived demolition and multiple moves
content: Santa Monica's last intact shotgun house, built in 1897, faced demolition and several moves. Community efforts and preservation groups saved the structure from disappearing entirely. The house was moved multiple times before finding its permanent location in 2014. It was then restored and repurposed as a Preservation Resource Center. This historic building now educates the public about local history and preservation principles.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife sets new record with donations to historically Black colleges
content: MacKenzie Scott has now donated over one billion dollars to historically Black colleges. Her recent forty-two million dollar gift to Elizabeth City State University marked this milestone. Scott has provided significant funding to numerous institutions since 2020. These unrestricted donations empower universities to allocate funds as needed. Her extensive philanthropic efforts support various educational and community initiatives.

title: ‘This isn’t politics’: Brian Lara backs Imran Khan, calls for dignity and proper care
content: Brian Lara and Pat Cummins join former captains supporting Imran Khan's treatment.  They are calling for independent medical assessments and humane care.  Concerns focus on Khan's reported vision problems while in custody.  Khan denies corruption charges, which supporters claim are politically motivated.  This appeal highlights basic humanity for a respected cricket legend.

title: Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump build wealth through brands and real estate
content: Vanessa Trump's wealth stems from family investments and real estate holdings. Tiger Woods built a diverse business empire through golf and various ventures. Woods' TGR Ventures oversees golf course design and sports entertainment projects. His portfolio includes fashion, hospitality, and technology investments. Both individuals have significant real estate assets contributing to their financial standing.

title: Travis Kelce grows business empire with $53m hydration deal
content: Travis Kelce expanded his growing business portfolio by joining organic hydration company Recover 180 as an investor and brand partner. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end highlighted the importance of quality hydration for peak performance and recovery. The move added to his partnerships across fashion, fitness, food and lifestyle brands. At the same time, Kelce remained focused on football, making it clear that winning another Super Bowl was his biggest goal.

title: Naomi Osaka vs Coco Gauff: Who has built more wealth in 2026?
content: Naomi Osaka and Coco Gauff are two of tennis’ most marketable stars in 2026, but they reached that status via different routes. Osaka has built a much wider business and branding empire alongside her Grand Slam career, and Gauff’s endorsement income and corporate interests have exploded in a short time; the pair’s combined net worth is a sign of the growing financial power of women’s tennis.

title: Watch: US strikes 3 Iranian oil tankers after Iran targets 2 navy warships
content: In a tense confrontation, US forces targeted three Iranian oil tankers after missile strikes on Navy warships. The vessels successfully dodged multiple Iranian attacks without any injuries reported. Serving as financial support for Iran's Revolutionary Guard and proxies, one tanker was rendered useless near Kharg Island, while another faced destruction close to Jask, with the last one obliterated in the Gulf of Oman as its crew evacuated.

title: Census 2027: The 14 questions and why opposition fears an NPR 'backdoor'
content: Enumerators have begun the decennial headcount in Ladakh and snowbound regions. New questions in the Census questionnaire have raised opposition concerns about its purpose. Critics allege the Census is becoming a backdoor for the National Population Register. The Census Act legally protects personal information collected during the exercise. Experts debate the data's use and potential privacy implications.

title: Putin orders 3-day pause in strikes on Kyiv as US delegation arrives in Russia
content: US special representatives Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow for crucial peace talks. President Putin ordered a three-day halt to strikes on Kyiv for the American delegation's visit. Both Russia and Ukraine had intensified long-range attacks before this diplomatic engagement. The US push aims to revive efforts to end the ongoing conflict between the nations. The envoys will travel to Ukraine after concluding their discussions in Russia.

title: Harmanpreet creates history, becomes first cricketer ever to captain in 150 T20Is
content: In a remarkable achievement, Harmanpreet Kaur captained her 150th T20I match during the Women's Asia Cup against Pakistan, solidifying her status as a leading figure in women's cricket. Her focus remains on enjoying the sport rather than tallying numbers, and this milestone places her ahead of many celebrated male captains in T20I history.

title: A home run for workers? Daman & Diu’s SPARSH 2.0 opens more rental space
content: The SPARSH 2.0 initiative is designed to stimulate the development of affordable rental housing by offering developers enticing incentives such as increased floor space index and enhanced ground coverage options. To qualify, developments must dedicate sixty-six percent of their units to economically weaker sections, promoting worker welfare and increasing industrial productivity. This initiative will be in effect across Daman, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, and Diu until 2027.

title: ‘Don’t give me these useless jumlas’: Kangana pulls up officials over unused funds
content: BJP MP Kangana Ranaut expressed anger over delayed development works. She questioned the utilization of nearly eleven crore rupees allocated for projects. Officials had repeatedly assured her that funds were being used effectively. However, external surveys revealed a different and concerning reality on the ground. Ranaut demanded immediate completion of pending works and accountability from officials.

title: At least 22 killed in fire at wedding party in Congo’s Kinshasa
content: A devastating fire at a wedding party in Kinshasa claimed at least twenty-two lives. The blaze erupted overnight Friday and continued into Saturday morning in the Lingwala district. Many people were injured as they attempted to escape the rapidly spreading flames. Narrow hallways caused congestion, hindering escape efforts for those trapped inside. The exact cause of the tragic fire remains unconfirmed by authorities.

title: ‘No handshake’ again: Harmanpreet, Fatima avoid customary gesture at Asia Cup toss
content: The long-standing no-handshake tradition persisted between the captains of India and Pakistan during the Asia Cup match. In Dubai, Fatima Sana won the toss and elected to bat first. Notably, Harmanpreet Kaur marked her 150th T20I match as captain. With both teams already in the semi-finals, India's aim remains to uphold their dominance over Pakistan.

title: Raina’s blueprint for India: Backs Abhishek for Test, calls Pant white-ball 'X-factor'
content: Suresh Raina expressed confidence in Abhishek Sharma's potential to succeed in Test cricket. He also highlighted Rishabh Pant as an impressive asset in white-ball formats. Notably, Pant has become a pivotal figure in India's red-ball squad. Raina's insights on fostering player development and promoting Test cricket engagement were shared during an interview on Aakash Chopra's YouTube channel.

title: Where have all the buyers gone? DC homes lose value as demand dries up
content: In Washington, the housing market is revealing an intriguing dynamic, with many properties available at discounted rates—almost one-fifth of homes listed currently are priced lower than what they were purchased for initially. This development points to a slump in buyer interest instead of a surplus of homes for sale. Luxury regions may see upward price trajectories, yet affordable condos are struggling.

title: ‘Always in chaos’: Hayden’s blunt verdict on Pakistan cricket amid latest turmoil
content: Matthew Hayden, the former Australian cricket opener, shared his insights on the persistent instability within Pakistan cricket. He emphasised how this ongoing chaos hampers players' ability to perform consistently. Despite Pakistan's wealth of natural talent, Hayden argued that the country's issues hinder its chances to harness that potential into becoming a cricketing powerhouse on the global stage.

title: Messi and Ronaldo could finally play together for first time after special invite
content: Carlos Tevez is planning a star-studded farewell match at Boca Juniors’ La Bombonera, with Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo both invited. Tevez hopes to reunite the longtime rivals as teammates for one night, alongside legends including Rooney, Scholes, Pirlo, Ferdinand, Vidic, Buffon and Van der Sar. The Argentine says he is confident he can persuade both superstars to attend.

title: 'Age just a number': Ishan Kishan confident of 'hungry' Shami making India comeback
content: Veteran pacer Mohammed Shami expresses his intense desire to return to the Indian cricket team. Ishan Kishan highlights Shami's relentless ambition and performance during the Duleep Trophy matches. His exceptional bowling and valuable batting contributions have caught the attention of his captain. The final sees East Zone striving for their first Duleep Trophy title in over a decade, featuring numerous international players and white-ball icons.

title: ‘Very strange’: Minor’s counsel questions police intent over Bhardwaj’s custody
content: Social media 'influencer' Swatantra Bhardwaj was arrested and sent to one-day police custody. This development followed an alleged assault on a CJP protester's father at Jantar Mantar. Police added provisions of the SC/ST Act and criminal intimidation to the FIR. A fresh FIR was also registered under the POCSO Act for online threats. Bhardwaj's arrest came after CJP representatives demanded action against him.

title: ‘Babar Azam the next target?’: Ex-Pakistan captain launches scathing attack on PCB
content: The Pakistan Cricket Board is under fire for its management of the national cricket team. Former captain Rashid Latif has accused the board of operating through remote control. The unexpected changes to players and coaching staff mid-series have sparked widespread criticism, further questioning the board's decision-making abilities. As the national Test team battles in the World Test Championship standings, these issues continue to mount.

title: Was the Hugging Face attack AI's 'Agent Smith breaks free' moment?
content: Agent Smith broke free from The Matrix and became a free program. AI appears to have done that with the Hugging Face attack. Are we finally reaching a phase where humans can no longer control AI?

title: LeT terrorist killed in J&K: Yasir was behind 2024 attack on IAF convoy, civilians
content: Yasir was gunned down on Friday during Operation Ashdar, launched after security forces received intelligence about the movement of a group of terrorists through the Pir Panjal mountains. Jammu and Kashmir Police identified the slain terrorist as Yasir and said he was affiliated with the banned Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT). The police also posted a message on X after the operation, saying, "You Can Run But You Can't Hide!"

title: 7-year-old dies as brick column collapses during Dahi Handi celebrations in Mumbai
content: A seven-year-old boy tragically died during a local Dahi Handi celebration in Malad West.  The accident occurred when a brick column collapsed on the child while playing.  He was rushed to Malvani General Hospital for immediate medical attention.  However, hospital authorities later confirmed the boy was declared brought dead.  The incident took place at Ekta Welfare Society in Chikuwadi, Malvani.

title: Kimi Antonelli heads into Monza GP as first Italian championship leader since 1953
content: Andrea Kimi Antonelli enters his home race leading the 2026 Formula 1 championship, becoming the first Italian driver to hold this position before Monza in over seven decades. With an impressive six wins and six pole positions under his belt this season, the stakes heighten as he faces a grid penalty for a power-unit change at the renowned Monza circuit, making this race all the more captivating.

title: From weed smell to a wardrobe fix: Sabalenka, Alcaraz light up unusual US Open day
content: Aryna Sabalenka complained about cannabis smoke during her US Open match.  Kamilla Rakhimova was defeated by Sabalenka in straight sets.  Casper Ruud previously mentioned the pervasive smell of marijuana in New York.  Carlos Alcaraz adjusted his playing attire due to wardrobe concerns.  The Williams sisters experienced a doubles match defeat after a significant lead.

title: Lorry hits BRS president KT Rama Rao’s car in Telangana
content: KT Rama Rao's car experienced a minor collision at Alugunuru junction. A lorry brushed the vehicle's rear door as it was being opened. The BRS leader was inside the car and escaped the incident unhurt. The accident caused slight damage to the car door and brief panic. Rama Rao continued his scheduled program despite the minor mishap.

title: ‘CSK captaincy must be changed’: Sanju Samson backed to take over from Ruturaj
content: As Chennai Super Kings prepares for the 2027 season, discussions emerge around the potential of Sanju Samson taking over the captaincy, especially with Ruturaj Gaikwad's performance raising questions. Former cricketer Sadagoppan Ramesh endorses Samson for his invaluable experience and impressive 50% success rate as an IPL captain. CSK must also navigate the future of their coaching staff and the legendary MS Dhoni.

title: DTC fought conductor for 32 years over Rs 67, now fined Rs 1 lakh by Delhi HC
content: The Delhi High Court has imposed a fine of one lakh rupees on the Delhi Transport Corporation for its relentless pursuit of a thirty-two-year-old legal battle involving a bus conductor. The court criticized the drawn-out litigation as an abuse of the legal system. The conductor had been seeking seventeen months of unpaid wages following his dismissal, while the court dismissed DTC's challenge to a tribunal ruling.

content: The manufacturer of the vaccine has denied producing the ‘misbranded’ vials bearing batch number KE25012 which failed a potency test by the Central Drugs Laboratory

content: At least six deaths of children were reported in June and August in Madhya Pradesh’s Balaghat district; a senior health official tells The Hindu that investigations are examining the combined role of measles, malaria, respiratory illness, malnutrition, anaemia, dehydration, and delayed access to treatment

content: The court held that a birth certificate is a statutory record of a child's birth and parentage. The subsequent dissolution of the biological parents' marriage or the remarriage of either parent does not, by itself, alter those facts.

title: Congress replaces Bhupesh Baghel with Sachin Pilot as Punjab general secretary
content:
Sachin Pilot replaces Bhupesh Baghel as Congress gereral secretary for Punjab

NEW DELHI: The Congress on Saturday appointed Sachin Pilot as the party’s general secretary in-charge of Punjab, replacing Bhupesh Baghel, news agency PTI reported. The appointment comes as Congress prepares to strengthen its organisation and political strategy in the state ahead of the Punjab assembly elections. Congress had appointed former Chhattisgarh chief minister Bhupesh Baghel as an AICC general secretary and made him the party’s Punjab in-charge in 2025. A prominent OBC leader, Baghel was credited with helping revive the Congress in Chhattisgarh and led the party to a landslide victory in the 2018 assembly elections. He served as chief minister from 2018 to 2023, with his tenure focusing on pro-farmer policies and rural development. Congress, however, lost the 2023 Chhattisgarh polls to the BJP, with Vishnu Deo Sai subsequently becoming chief minister.
